description: This file defines the PHP class `SSOClient` which is part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to interact with the AWS Single Sign-On service, including synchronous and asynchronous methods for operations like retrieving role credentials, listing account roles, listing accounts, and logout.

classes.name: SSOClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Single Sign-On service, extending the base AwsClient class. It provides methods for common SSO operations.

methods.name: getRoleCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves role credentials for the specified role and account for the current user.

methods.name: getRoleCredentialsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves role credentials for the specified role and account.

methods.name: listAccountRoles
methods.description: Lists roles available for the specified account.

methods.name: listAccountRolesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists roles available for the specified account.

methods.name: listAccounts
methods.description: Lists all AWS accounts the user has access to.

methods.name: listAccountsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all AWS accounts the user has access to.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user from the AWS SSO session.

methods.name: logoutAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously logs out the current user from the AWS SSO session.
